newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-MASHONOLAND SET E.PROVINCE TARGET OF 268/8.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-MASHONOLAND SET E.PROVINCE TARGET OF 268/8.

text.p: A typically cultured century from Grant Flower and some brutal late hitting powered Mashonoland to an impressive 268 for eight in their Standard Bank Cup quarter-final against Eastern Province at St George's Park on Wednesday.

The Zimbabwean provincial champions -- eight of whom were regulars for their country in the recent triangular one-day series with South Africa and India -- paced their innings perfectly after winning the toss.
Grant Flower put on 71 in 15 overs for the first wicket with brother Andy before the latter became the first of two players to be run out by direct hits from EP's Ashwell Prince.
The surviving brother went on to reach three figures in only 107 balls but his dismissal two balls later made no difference to the tempo.
David Houghton hit 28 in 25 balls, Craig Evans 29 in 21 balls and Eddo Brandes clubbed an undefeated 32 in 15 balls to lift Mashonoland beyond the 250 mark.
Bowling: Hayward 9-0-47-3, Ferreira 9-1-62-0, Baptiste 9-1-55-1, Callaghan 9-1-53-0, Shaw 9-0-46-1.
